lines.zh: 我的螺壳划开海水，慢慢向前。
lines.en: My shell parts the water as I glide forward.

lines.zh: 一步一步，海底的沙很软。
lines.en: Step by step, the seabed sand is soft.

lines.zh: 这具长壳比我先到，我背着走。
lines.en: This long shell arrived before me, and I carry it along.

lines.zh: 触手探路，我顺着洋流挪。
lines.en: Tentacles scouting ahead, I drift along the current.
No rush, this prehistoric sea is vast.
Shell tip trailing behind, I crawl forward.
Hundreds of small tentacles sway together.
The water holds me, and I move steadily.
I cross the coral, treading lightly.
Slow down, so I can smell the school of fish.

lines.zh: 这身壳体是我最重的行李。
lines.en: This shell is the heaviest luggage I own.
I patrol along the edge of the shelf.
I know the roads of the Ordovician well.
One step at a time, deeper still.
I round the reef and keep going.
My long shell leaves a thin wake.
Patrolling is my daily lesson.

lines.zh: 谁在前面？我先挪过去看看。
lines.en: Who is ahead? I'll slide over and look.

lines.zh: 壳尖朝前，我悬在暗水里。
lines.en: Shell tips forward; I hang in the dark water.
Tentacles drawn in, I wait for fish.
Let the sea breathe for me.

lines.zh: 静下来，能听见远处的鳞响。
lines.en: Quiet now, I can hear distant scales stir.
I rest in this moment, unhurried.
It is quiet inside my shell, and I am at ease.
The ancient sea is silent, and I stare with it.
I am counting the fish shadows passing by.

lines.zh: 一动不动，是最省力的狩猎。
lines.en: Staying still is the cheapest hunt.
The current slips past the rim of my shell.

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨眼，虽然没人看见。
lines.en: I blink slowly, though no one sees.
This is my undersea afternoon.

lines.zh: 停一停，潮水总会带来东西。
lines.en: Wait a while; the tide always brings something.

lines.zh: 我们这种老家伙，最会等。
lines.en: Old ones like me are best at waiting.

lines.zh: 你身上有鱼腥味，我看看。
lines.en: You smell of fish; let me look at you.

lines.zh: 这么小的东西，敢靠近我？
lines.en: Something this small dares approach me?

lines.zh: 我转过头，把你打量一遍。
lines.en: I turn and size you up.

lines.zh: 你的影子落进我的海里了。
lines.en: Your shadow has fallen into my sea.
I cannot find a shell on you.
Stand still and let me scent you.
No fins, so how did you get down here?
My eyes are on you now.
You look like a meal.

lines.zh: 别动，我看得见你每一寸。
lines.en: Don't move; I see every inch of you.
You dare strike my shell?!
That hurts; my tentacles have curled in.

lines.zh: 壳被敲出裂纹，我沉下去。
lines.en: A crack in my shell; I sink lower.
My shell rings from the hit.
I am not used to being hit.
That one reached soft flesh.
I will make you pay.
Keep away from my shell mouth!
I yield half a step, then bite back.
It stings, but I can still swim.

lines.zh: 那股鱼味，让我壳都发痒。
lines.en: That fish smell makes my shell itch.
Fish! I smell fish!

lines.zh: 你手里那点鲜味归我了。
lines.en: That fresh thing in your hand is mine.

lines.zh: 我的触手自己伸出去了。
lines.en: My tentacles reach out on their own.
Stop swaying, I want that fish.
This scent makes me forget my patrol.

lines.zh: 为了这口鱼，我肯靠近你。
lines.en: For that bite, I'll come closer to you.

lines.zh: 我慢慢跟过来，只为那腥香。
lines.en: I follow slowly, just for that fishy tang.
The glint of fish scales is luring me.
A little closer and I can take it.
Ran into my shell, did that hurt?
This shell wall is hard as a stone pillar.
Stop pushing; my shell won't give way.

lines.zh: 你碰到我的触手了，退开。
lines.en: You touched my tentacles; back off.
I bump back with the tip of my shell.
I hold this seabed path first.
One bump is enough, don't try again.
My shell does not welcome shoving.

lines.zh: 你被弹开，是海水的意思。
lines.en: You were pushed back; the water decided it.

lines.zh: 撞我等于撞一整支石锥。
lines.en: Hitting me is hitting a whole row of stone spikes.
A shell of my own kind draws near.
Our tentacles twine together.

lines.zh: 这片海域适合留下后代。
lines.en: This stretch of sea suits leaving young behind.

lines.zh: 慢慢来，史前的爱情也很慢。
lines.en: Slowly now; prehistoric love is slow too.

lines.zh: 我一向独自巡游，除了此刻。
lines.en: I always patrol alone, except right now.
Your shell's ridges suit mine.
Let the current carry our eggs away.

lines.zh: 我收拢触手，向她靠过去。
lines.en: I draw in my tentacles and lean toward her.

lines.zh: 这季节，海底也该热闹些。
lines.en: This season, the seabed should be lively too.
Swimming side by side a while is enough.
I pick up the broken shell from the seabed.

lines.zh: 这块东西有点意思，收了。
lines.en: This piece is interesting; I'll keep it.

lines.zh: 我用触手把它卷进壳口。
lines.en: I curl it into my shell mouth with a tentacle.

lines.zh: 背着这具长壳，我捡东西很慢。
lines.en: Carrying this long shell, I pick things up slowly.
Little thing, hold on for me.
I like rummaging in the sand.

lines.zh: 沉底的东西，总归是我的。
lines.en: What sinks to the bottom is mine in the end.
I hide it deep inside my shell.
This little find will amuse me a while.
I pick it up and resume my patrol.
That fish has caught my eye.
Target locked; tentacles go first.
I have found dinner.
The prey moved, so I moved.
Lock on, close in, no hurry.
That shadow won't escape.
I have decided to chase it.
It has wandered into my hunting ground.
Good, I'll start with this one.
I turn on the prey, shell tip aimed.
Almost there; I keep closing in.
It wants to hide? My tentacles are longer.
I keep my gaze fixed on that glint of scales.
The ripples give away its position.
Circle round slowly, don't startle it.
I am measuring the distance.

lines.zh: 它每动一次，我就近一步。
lines.en: Each time it moves, I gain a step.
Patience; every old hunter knows it.
Energy gathers in my shell, ready to lunge.

lines.zh: 快了，猎物的影子就在眼前。
lines.en: Nearly there; the prey's shadow is right before me.
Tentacles wrap, and the prey cannot move.

lines.zh: 我的喙咬下去，水都红了。
lines.en: My beak bites down, and the water reddens.
Wrap, tighten, just like that.
I drag you beneath my shell.

lines.zh: 这一击来自看不见的深处。
lines.en: This blow comes from unseen depths.
A tentacle lashes you, and it lands hard.
Stop struggling; the beak is aimed at you.
I crush hard shells in one bite.

lines.zh: 海水替我盖住你的喊声。
lines.en: The sea covers your cry for me.

lines.zh: 这就是奥陶纪的咬合力。
lines.en: This is Ordovician bite force.

lines.zh: 我从幽暗的古海浮上来。
lines.en: I rise from the dim ancient sea.
The long shell breaks the surface first, then me.
The hunter of the Ordovician has returned.

lines.zh: 四亿年前的规矩，还记得吗？
lines.en: Do you still recall the rules of four hundred million years ago?
I arrive barnacle-covered.
The seabed splits and I rise slowly.

lines.zh: 这片水域，从此归我巡游。
lines.en: These waters are mine to patrol from now on.

lines.zh: 我来了，带着壳尖的寒气。
lines.en: I am here, with cold at the tip of my shell.

lines.zh: 古代的鱼群要开始逃了。
lines.en: The ancient shoals will start to flee.
Rising from the deep, I arrive.

lines.zh: 我的影子先落在你身上。
lines.en: My shadow settles on you before I do.

lines.zh: 听见了吗？螺壳摩擦海底的声音。
lines.en: Hear that? A shell scraping the seabed.

lines.zh: 水里的火也烫伤了我的触手。
lines.en: Even underwater fire scorches my tentacles.

lines.zh: 我从水面重重摔回海底。
lines.en: I crash from the surface back to the seabed.

lines.zh: 我这种老螺，也会被水呛住。
lines.en: Even an old shell like me can choke on water.

lines.zh: 炸开的水压震裂了我的壳。
lines.en: The blast's pressure cracks my shell.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进了我的软体。
lines.en: An arrow sinks into my soft body.

lines.zh: 那股怪力钻进壳里，很麻。
lines.en: Strange force seeps into my shell and numbs me.
Too hungry to even stretch a tentacle.

lines.zh: 雷电顺着海水穿进我的壳。
lines.en: Lightning threads through the water into my shell.

lines.zh: 虚空把我的壳一点点吞掉。
lines.en: The void swallows my shell bit by bit.
